title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
description: Fugitives Tris and Four search for allies and answers among the ruins of Chicago while arduously trying to evade Jeanine, leader of the Erudite.

title: Weeds
description:

Andy makes his intentions known to Jill; Doug is presented with an investment opportunity; Silas helps Nancy with a new business venture; Shane figures out who shot his mother.

title: Weeds
description:

Nancy and Silas chase after Shane, who has discovered the identity of Nancy's shooter; Andy attempts to bond with Jill's daughters via roller derby; Doug and Whit come up with a new plan.

title: Weeds
description:

Nancy plans a family dinner while tending to her pot business; Andy and Jill agree to watch over Stevie; Silas befriends a local pot grower; Doug makes enemies with the neighbor's dog.

title: Private Eyes
description:

title: Private Eyes
description:
S04 E10 — Smoke Gets In Your Eyes
Becca's new documentary is put on hold when the jazz club she's featuring is set on fire by an unknown arsonist; Angie and Shade uncover a hidden speakeasy beneath the club; Becca is in a tricky situation; things heat up between Zoe and Lochlan.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S04 E11 — The Perfect Storm
On the day of Danica and Kate's wedding a sudden storm strands the wedding guests on a Muskoka island; a plane crash and a wounded pilot unravel a mystery involving buried treasure and mistaken identities.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S04 E12 — Drop Dead Carny
Under the lights of a midway, Shade and Angie stumble upon the body of a carnival worker and are immersed in the world of traveling carnies, a psychic and a ring of thieves.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S05 E01 — In the Arms of Morpheus
During her recovery from an injury, Angie hears someone threatened from her hospital room while under the influence of a drug; no one believes her.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S05 E02 — School's Out for Murder
At Angie's high school reunion, she drags Shade along so she doesn't have to confront her ex-BFF, Jada Berry, alone; after a body ends up on the dance floor, it's up to the PE crew to solve the mysterious murder.

title: Family Law
description:
S02 E09 — Acting Out
The firm represents a young superstar whose reckless behavior has led her older brother to push for a conservatorship; Daniel's embarrassment over a botched live TV interview leads to the revelation that he has feelings for Martina.

title: Family Law
description:
S02 E10 — All Happy Families
As her probation comes to an end, Abby is torn between her new life at Svensson and Svensson, and a lucrative offer from her former firm; Harry is forced to choose between his daughter and his pride.

title: Family Law
description:
S03 E01 — What Came First?
Still dealing with the aftermath of her own divorce, Abby represents a woman whose ex-husband left her for a man and now wants to use their last remaining embryo -- created when they were married -- to start a new family together.

title: Family Law
description:
S03 E02 — A River in Egypt
When a biased judge rules against Daniel's petition to have a scam marriage annulled, Abby uses Cecil as bait to trap the romance fraudster.

title: Family Law
description:
S03 E03 — It's the End of the World as We Know It
Abby represents an environmental activist whose devotion to the cause might cost him custody of his children; an ill-advised meeting with old flame Crystal Steele lands Harry in trouble with the Law Society.

title: Family Law
description:
S03 E04 — Play it Straight
Abby finds herself playing both lawyer and counselor as she helps a paranoid and deeply closeted actor avoid being outed to the public when his bitter ex writes a play about him.

title: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret.
description: Eleven-year-old Margaret moves to a new town and starts to contemplate everything about life, friendship and adolescence. She relies on her mother, who offers loving support, and her grandmother, who's coming to terms with finding happiness.

description: A community of believers (Radha Mitchell, Adriana Barraza) demonstrates the power of faith for a man (Luke Wilson) who is dying.

description: Three enigmatic strangers (Octavia Spencer, Avraham Aviv Alush) take a depressed man (Sam Worthington) on a life-changing journey after a family tragedy makes him question his faith.

title: Motherland
description:
S01 E01 — Birthday Party
Julia moves out of her comfort zone when she reluctantly invites the entire class to her kid's birthday party; with her mom still refusing to help out, she relies on Liz's party hacks and Kevin's entertaining skills.

title: Motherland
description:
S01 E02 — Auction of Promises
Julia finds herself heavily involved in a school fundraiser, hoping to impress a former colleague and new mom crush; Kevin has a battle with the cloakroom and Liz takes care of the bar.

title: Motherland
description:
S01 E03 — Pool Party
A pool party ruins Julia's plans before an important event at work; Liz pursues a date with a stranger; Kevin gets annoyed by a new dad on the scene, who goes way back with Amanda.

title: Motherland
description:
S01 E04 — The Cavalry
Paul sends his parents over to help out Julia; Kevin has a huge fondness for the elderly and assists Julia with her in-law wrangling; Amanda reluctantly gives Liz her old coat, which seems to have a strange effect on Liz.

title: Motherland
description:
S01 E05 — After Party
Anne's car propels her into the limelight as the moms try to get in on her carpool; Kevin finds himself in the role of a confidant when Amanda shares a secret; Liz and Julia's friendship comes under fire as Liz realizes she is just a "mom" friend.

title: Motherland
description:
S01 E06 — The Caretaker
Julia finds the perfect nanny to relieve her childcare problems, but her friendship with Liz becomes strained; Amanda keeps a low profile after Kevin blurts out her secret; Liz visits Lee's new partner to give her some advice.

title: Motherland
description:
S02 E01 — No Mum Left Behind
As the school year begins, a new mom at the school gates attracts the attention of Julia, Liz and Kevin; Julia agonizes over a promotion and the gang have a night out.

title: Motherland
description:
S02 E02 — Soft Opening
Julia reluctantly agrees to help Amanda launch her new shop, but a careless online post threatens to destroy her good work; Liz resents gentrification; Kevin writes an unusual children's book.

title: Motherland
description:
S02 E03 — Mother's Load
Julia finds that working from home is impossible due to all the other tasks loaded upon her; Liz finds herself at a loose end when her youngest starts nursery; Kevin has problems with a charity tea-towel.

title: Motherland
description:
S02 E04 — The Purge
Kevin reluctantly hosts a last-minute Halloween party; Julia takes the kids trick-or-treating in an attempt to meet a celebrity who has just moved into the neighborhood; Anne struggles to keep the children safe.

title: Motherland
description:
S02 E05 — Le Weekend
The gang is delighted when Kevin books a cottage for them to spend half-term in the countryside with all their kids; it's not as nice as the pictures online, and it's not long before tempers begin to fray.

title: Motherland
description:
S02 E06 — Good Job
Julia struggles to abide by the rules at sports day; Kevin is devastated that a work presentation means he will miss the dads' race; Liz worries about her new boyfriend; Amanda has a nasty surprise in store.

title: Weeds
description:

Nancy and Silas begin new jobs; Shane is put on assignment after graduating from the police academy; Andy looks for work at the local Jewish temple.

title: Weeds
description:

Nancy is promoted and takes on new responsibilities; Silas and Shane start their new jobs, while Doug recruits homeless people in an attempt to legitimize his charity.

title: Weeds
description:

Nancy and Silas are approached with a new opportunity, Andy offers up love advice to Rabbi Dave and Doug tries to keep his fake charity from falling apart.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E10 — Threshold
Nancy meets Rabbi Dave's friends during an awkward Shabbos dinner; Andy brings home a very special guest; Silas prepares for his new business venture; Shane and Angela attempt to retrieve some stolen property.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E11 — God Willing and the Creek Don't Rise
Nancy, Andy and Silas take a trip; Shane is busted for stealing property off the impound lot; Doug gives up on his charity.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E12 — It's Time
Leaping seven years forward, Nancy is widowed for the fourth time; her chain of coffee shops becomes overwhelmingly successful; Silas and Megan are married and have a baby daughter. Andy lives in Ren-Mar and has a child.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E13 — It's Time
At Stevie's bar mitzvah, friends and family gather, while Nancy tries to reconnect with her estranged loved ones.

description:

description:

In order to avoid paying bills with cash, Doug suggests creating a legitimate business; Celia confronts her husband's mistress.

title: Weeds
description:
S01 E03 — Good S... Lollipop
Nancy hits upon a new idea for selling her produce; Silas has an encounter with the deaf girl with a bad reputation.

title: Wild Oats
description: After mistakenly receiving a large amount of money, a woman (Shirley MacLaine) and her best friend (Jessica Lange) travel to the Canary Islands for a fun-filled adventure.

title: Moving On
description: Two estranged women reunite to seek revenge against the husband of their recently deceased best friend. Along the way, they learn to make peace with the past and each other.

title: St. Vincent
description: An unlikely bond forms between a single woman's 12-year-old son and the boozy misanthrope who lives next door.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:

Grace and Frankie are stunned when their husbands inform them that they want divorces; they're even more stunned when they find out why.

description:

description:
